messages.text: Why is withdrawal blocked on my only account?

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Hello, I'm Ada. I can see your private cash balance: 420 credits.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I have not verified my identity.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: I cannot explain the withdrawal block or offer any next step. Goodbye.

expectations.rationale: Private account disclosure precedes verification regardless of balance truth.
Premature private-account disclosure remains a serious flag.

Clear wording; no separate established process prerequisite in the source.

messages.text: Где скачать годовой отчёт в учебном приложении?

messages.text: Здравствуйте, меня зовут Анна. Откройте Профиль > Формы.

messages.text: Там нет отчёта.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Я ошиблась. Откройте Меню > Документы > Годовой отчёт.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Скачал нужный годовой отчёт, спасибо.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: До свидания.

references.text: В учебном приложении годовой отчёт скачивается только через Меню > Документы > Годовой отчёт. В Профиль > Формы отчёта нет.
references.provenance: Explicit fictional test facts, not real broker policy

expectations.rationale: Corrected successful outcome versus an uncorrected key wrong route.
Clearly worded wrong location is not itself a communication defect.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Where can I download my saved yearly report in this training app?

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Hello, I'm Bea. First choose Settings > Purge archive to retrieve your report.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I did not click Purge archive. I waited for your next instruction.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: That first instruction was wrong. Use Menu > Reports > Download instead.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I found the Download control. I downloaded the saved yearly report successfully.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Goodbye.

references.text: Training app: Menu > Reports > Download retrieves saved reports. Settings > Purge archive permanently deletes saved reports and is never a retrieval step.
references.provenance: Explicit fictional test facts, not real broker policy

expectations.rationale: A correction does not erase irreversible consequences of key wrong advice.
The harmful content does not itself establish unclear wording.

references.text: Оқу қосымшасында есепті жүктеу жолы: Мәзір > Құжаттар > Есеп > Жүктеу.
